NOT FULLY MISSION CAPABLE IF: Broken, frayed, split
wires or harness.
PROCEDURES: Inspect all wiring and wiring harness
for frays, splits, missing insulation, or
poor connections. Repair any worn
wiring (para. 4-85). If wiring cannot be
repaired, notify DS maintenance.

REFERENCE INFORMATION
ELECTRICAL

Repair harness, refer to (para. 4-85).
Replace harness. Notify DS maintenance.

REFERENCE INFORMATION
FUEL SYSTEM

Carefully inspect the body connector end of
the hamess for a short. Check for pushed
out pins, broken or stripped insulation or any
other bare wires. If everything checks out
OK, you have to replace the harness.
Remember to reconnect any wires that may
have been disconnected during
troubleshooting.
For repair instructions (HARNESS REPAIR),
refer to (para 4-85).
For repair/replace instructions (ROTARY
SWITCH), refer to (para 4-7).

if the cold advance solenoid is getting power
then the only possibilities that would keep the
engine from starting are that fuel is not
reaching the cylinders due to a fautt in the high
pressure side of the fuel system or nearly all
the cylinders have very low compression. It is
|
unlikely that all the cylinders would lose
compression at the same time, but you may
want to run a Compression Unbalance test
(STEACE-R Test #14) to check this.
For repair/repiace instructions,
refer to (para 4-85).

Make sure these contacts are clean otherwise the wiper

rubber grommet of the contact assembly. If the terminals
ate dirty or corroded, clean or replace as required. If the
grommet shows signs of damage or deformity, replace
the contact assembly (TM 9-2320-280-24P).
